policy.scope: body-reading http-response scripts in the combined module and independent ad modules; defaults allowed at the iOS 1 MiB limit
policy.oversize_behavior: Surge bypasses the response script and forwards the original response

semantic_change: For the affected HTTP response scripts, responses over 1048576 decompressed bytes are passed through without script execution. Script behavior for bodies within the cap is unchanged. This cap does not bound total Surge memory, native Body Rewrite processing or request bodies.
